profile.headline: Tech Enthusiast | AI Practitioner | Computer Vision | Machine learning | Investor
profile.summary:
* Proven AI and autonomous driving leader with 10+ years industry experience, including 8+ years of direct experience in autonomous and robotic systems development. 
* Expertise in establishing AI-driven development processes and implementing strategies for reliability, robustness, and software quality of perception, sensor fusion, mapping, and end-to-end ML models for
safety-critical AD/ADAS applications. 
* Led technical road-maps, cross-functional teams, and production deployments including simulation platforms, HIL validation, risk mitigation, and real-world autonomy solutions. 
* Deep proficiency in PyTorch/TensorFlow, C++/Python, data-driven validation, and scalable AI architectures.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building AI-driven development processes, including high-fidelity simulation platforms for training and
validating end-to-end vision-language-action and world-action models for next-generation heavy machine autonomy.
positions.insights: Management Professional, Architectural Design and +2 skills

positions.title: Autonomy Staff Engineer
positions.description:
- Co-led perception team developing ML-based 3D detection, multi-modal sensor fusion, and operator-assist collision mitigation systems; applied data-driven validation, risk assessments, and CI/CD to deliver fault-tolerant performance in safety-critical operations.
 
- Directed architectural design, production-intent software implementation, and scalable deployment while mentoring engineers on code quality, performance trade-offs, and risk mitigation.
 
- As Special Projects Team Lead, defined road-map from inception and successfully deployed an end-to-end reasoning model on heavy off-road equipment in controlled trials, proving robust integration and real-world readiness.
positions.insights: Team Leadership, Machine Learning and +4 skills

positions.title: Perception Architect, Automomy
positions.description: Architected multi-year technical road-maps and perception architectures for fully and semi-autonomous machines, driving reliability, robustness, and software quality through sensor fusion, mapping, HIL testing, simulation, and in-vehicle deployment on surrogate platforms.
positions.insights: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Technical Leadership and +2 skills

positions.title: Team Lead Manager/Senior Research Scientist
positions.description:
- Built and scaled ML platform for continuous learning by mining generic objects and rare events from autonomous
driving logs, enhancing neural network robustness, reliability, and software quality in real-world conditions.
positions.insights: Machine Learning, Scenario Testing and +2 skills

positions.title: Team Lead Manager/Senior Research Scientist
positions.description:
- Led development and deployment of the autonomous emergency brake system on first-generation AV platform,
defining requirements, perception algorithms, integration, testing, and validation processes that achieved TUV ̈
endorsement for public road driverless operations (Hyundai Motor Group joint venture).
- Owned end-to-end system and software requirements, perception development, and delivery of safety-critical
autonomy features, implementing strategies for reliability, robustness, and fault-tolerant performance.
- Scaled and supervised multiple teams (growing from 2 to 8 engineers); set OKRs, conducted data-driven progress evaluations, and provided mentoring and career coaching.
positions.insights: Project Management, Cross-functional Team Leadership and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed production software infrastructure for analytics of autonomous driving data logs and a
prototype deep learning-based system for emergency vehicle detection.
positions.insights: Software Development, Rapid Prototyping and +1 skill

positions.title: Early Career & Research Experience
positions.description:
• Software Engineer roles at Microsoft Azure and Avere Systems (acquired by Microsoft), developing scalable cloud
infrastructure, distributed systems, and automated testing frameworks.
• Post-doctoral research in computational chemistry/physics at Sandia National Labs and Northwestern University,
conducting large-scale simulations, ab initio calculations, and unsupervised dimensionality reduction methods.
• Senior Systems Administrator, University of Pittsburgh, managing critical research computing infrastructure.
positions.insights: Research and Development (R&D), Software Development and +2 skills
